description: Synthetic path spellings and finding fingerprints for sesslint.baseline parity (file_role, v2 keys, dump/filter/load/upgrade).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-baseline-file-role-cwd: file_role absolutizes bare relative spellings against the process working directory; vectors use rooted or virtual paths only.
GAP-baseline-write-baseline: write_baseline delegates to sesslint.atomic atomic_write_text; parity does not pin host directory layout or temp rename races.

GAP-baseline-parse-json-messages: Rust load_baseline uses the hand-written JSON reader in baseline.rs; malformed-document cases that differ from json.loads error text are covered in unit tests, not vectors.
